prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Katy, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1042; do not mention it.) Never use square brackets or placeholders of any kind.
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the collision at the intersection in Katy, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please describe in your own words what happened at the intersection.

A: I was driving through the green light heading east. A vehicle coming from the north side ran the red light and hit the passenger side of my car, right behind the front door.

Q: Were you able to stop or swerve before the impact?

A: No. It happened too fast. I saw the other car just as it entered my lane, and I tried to brake but there was no time.

Q: Did your airbags deploy?

A: The side airbag did, and the curtain airbag too, I think. My head hit the window pretty hard.

Q: How are you feeling now?

A: Not great. I have a bad headache, I feel dizzy when I stand up too quickly, and the light bothers my eyes. I saw a doctor at the urgent care clinic that afternoon, and they told me I have a concussion.

Q: Have you been able to return to work or your normal activities?

A: Not yet. I've been resting at home as the doctor advised, and I can only manage short periods of reading or screen time.

Q: Did anyone else ride in your vehicle at the time?

A: No, I was alone.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I'd appreciate a copy of the police report when it's available.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.

A: Thank you.
